description_zh: 报告称 Waymo AV 停在路边，一辆乘用车（ego）从左侧驶来擦碰其左侧后视镜。选择移动的乘用车为 ego，测其能否安全通过紧邻路边的静止车辆。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV was parked on the right side of East 8th Street when a passenger car approached from the left and made contact with the left side mirror of the Waymo AV.
evidence.reason: Waymo AV 静止、测试价值低，选移动的 passenger car 为 ego。DMV 标记：天气 A (Clear)、光线 A (Daylight)、路面 A (Dry)、碰撞类型 B (Side Swipe)、车辆1（Waymo AV）动作 O (Parked)。镜像接触 -> lateral=0.1。中午12:25->afternoon。
